articles.title: OKX brings OpenAI and Anthropic bets to Europe as pre-IPO trading grows
articles.snippet: The exchange is offering up to 10x leverage on private-company valuations alongside 100 tokenized stocks and ETFs.

articles.title: Nasdaq invests $100 million in Kraken parent company Payward at $21 billion valuation
articles.snippet: The investment expands a strategic partnership to bring tokenized, voting-enabled equities to crypto exchange users.

articles.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev fires back at AMC's Aron in escalating fight over stock tokens
articles.snippet: Tenev told CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Wednesday that public companies shouldn't have veto power over third-party securities that reference their shares.

articles.title: Ex-BoE deputy governor headlines trio of former central bankers joining Fnality
articles.snippet: Jon Cunliffe, Jochen Metzger and Ron Berndsen join Fnality Europe’s supervisory board as the company works to expand beyond its sterling payment system.

articles.title: Unicoin sues Uniswap Labs, seeks to cancel UNI registration
articles.snippet: The complaint says Uniswap’s counsel sent three letters before Unicoin’s Sept. 28 launch and seeks declarations on its marks and domains.
